mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, user_id, body) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{body})
mapper.sql: c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.body, c.created_at, c.updated_at, u.username AS author_username, u.name AS author_name, u.avatar_key AS author_avatar_key
mapper.select: SELECT FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.id = #{id}
